fields.description: OpenAI model id. gpt-6-astra is the strongest and the dearest (about USD 10 per million input and 50 per million output tokens); gpt-6.1-sol is a fifth of that. Press Test connection to see which models this key can use.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: One per line. Tried in order when the key cannot use the model above.
fields.label: Fallback Models

fields.description: How long the model thinks before answering. high and xhigh are slower and cost more; low is fine for simple invoices.
fields.label: Reasoning Effort

fields.description: Leave blank to use openai_api_key from site_config.json (recommended: bench --site sheikhmahboob.com set-config openai_api_key ...). Never paste the key anywhere else.
fields.label: OpenAI API Key (override)

fields.description: Let OpenAI keep the conversation state (previous_response_id), which it retains for 30 days; tool results include buyer names and masked NTN/CNIC. Faster; untick for a zero-data-retention account (the assistant then replays its own history).
fields.label: Store Conversation State on OpenAI

fields.description: Environment for drafts made by System Managers when they do not say Sandbox or Production. Client Panel users always get Production.
fields.label: Default Environment for Drafts

fields.description: Model-tools-model cycles allowed in one turn.
fields.label: Max Tool Rounds per Turn

fields.description: Wall-clock seconds for one turn (max 90). The desk request is cut at 120 seconds, so each model call only gets the time that is left.
fields.label: Turn Budget (seconds)

fields.description: Ceiling per model call, including the model's reasoning tokens. It is a limit, not a spend.
fields.label: Max Output Tokens per Call

fields.description: Messages one user may send per day. 0 disables the cap.
fields.label: Daily Messages per User

fields.description: UOM, rate and SRO lookups against FBR reference data, using the seller's own token.
fields.label: Allow FBR Reference Lookups

fields.description: Let the assistant run FBR validate on a draft when asked. It can never post.
fields.label: Allow FBR Validate

fields.description: Appended to the assistant's instructions. Example: "Always use Production for SUBHAN ENTERPRISES."
fields.label: Extra Instructions
